blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
HR uses numbers to understand people at work. These numbers are called metrics. For example, how many people work in the company? How many new people start every month? How many people leave? These are all HR metrics.

A KPI is a key performance indicator. It is a number that is very important for the team. When the KPI is good, the team is doing well.

Numbers help HR tell the story of the people. A good report shows the results in a clear way, so the team can see what is good and what to improve.

items.q: What are HR numbers called?
items.why: "These numbers are called metrics."

items.q: What does KPI mean?
items.why: "A KPI is a key performance indicator."

items.q: When the KPI is good, the team is…
items.why: "When the KPI is good, the team is doing well."

items.q: The text suggests that numbers are useful because they…
options: help HR understand and tell the story of the people
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que os números ajudam a entender e a contar a história das pessoas.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: one metric is enough for everything
a clear report helps the team improve
numbers are not important in HR
items.why: Inferência: o texto valoriza relatórios claros para mostrar resultados e melhorar.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Harry apresentar o relatório mensal de RH para a equipe. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, everyone. Thank you for coming. Today I want to show you the monthly HR report. There are only a few numbers, but they are important.

First, our headcount. There are two hundred people in the company now. Last month there were one hundred and ninety-five, so we have five new people. That is good news.

Now, turnover. Turnover is the percentage of people who leave. This month it is four percent. Last month it was six percent, so it is lower. When turnover goes down, we are happy.

Our main KPI is very simple: we want people to stay and to be happy at work. This number is better than last month. There is still work to do, but the team is doing well.

Please look at the report and tell me your questions. Remember, these numbers are not just numbers. They are people. Thank you.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Harry showing the team?
items.why: "Today I want to show you the monthly HR report."

items.q: How many people are in the company now?
items.why: "There are two hundred people in the company now."

items.q: What happened to turnover this month?
options: It went down to four percent
It went up to six percent
items.why: "This month it is four percent. Last month it was six percent, so it is lower."

items.q: Harry says the numbers "are people." This suggests he wants the team to…
options: remember the numbers are about real employees
items.why: Inferência: ele lembra que cada número representa uma pessoa de verdade.

items.q: How would you best describe Harry's message?
options: Positive, but there is still work to do
items.why: Inferência: os números melhoraram ("the team is doing well"), mas ele diz "there is still work to do".

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Our headcount is two hundred people." Headcount means…
items.why: Headcount = número de funcionários.

items.q: "Turnover is low this year." Turnover is…
options: the percentage of people who leave
items.why: Turnover = rotatividade, a porcentagem de pessoas que saem.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We use a ___ to compare two results, like 4% and 6%."
items.why: Percentage = porcentagem, usada para comparar resultados.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "HR wants to ___ the results, so it is better next month."
items.why: To improve = melhorar.

items.q: "We measure the numbers every month." To measure means to…
options: check the size or the value of something
items.why: To measure = medir, verificar o valor de algo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em reuniões sobre relatórios e números. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Turnover went up this month." This means it…
items.why: Go up = subir, ficar mais alto.

items.q: "Good news — the numbers went down." This means they…
items.why: Go down = descer, ficar mais baixo.

items.q: "We need to keep track of the headcount every month." This means to…
items.why: Keep track of = acompanhar, controlar ao longo do tempo.

items.q: "Harry will point out the main KPI in the report." This means he will…
items.why: Point out = apontar, destacar algo.

items.q: "Let's work out the percentage together." This means to…
items.why: Work out = calcular, chegar ao resultado.
